data.long_meaning: The name सतोष is derived from the Sanskrit word ‘सत्’ which means ‘truth, being’ and ‘तोष’ which means ‘contentment, joy, delight’. In Hindu mythology, the name is associated with Lord Shiva and represents the state of being content and at peace with oneself and the universe. The name सतोष carries the meaning “Contentment, Joy, Delight” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose सतोष usually hope their child will grow to embody contentment, joy, delight and live with faith, good character and purpose.
